001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.event.general;
002
003import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.event.AbstractQSEvent;
004import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.Shop;
005import lombok.Getter;
006import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
007import org.bukkit.inventory.Inventory;
008
009import java.util.List;
010
011@Getter
012public class ShopHistoryGuiOpenEvent extends AbstractQSEvent {
013
014  private final Player player;
015  private final List<Shop> shops;
016  private final Inventory inventory;
017
018  /**
019   * Called when user opened a Shop History GUI
020   *
021   * @param shops     The shops that related to GUI
022   * @param player    The player that open GUI
023   * @param inventory The GUI itself
024   */
025  public ShopHistoryGuiOpenEvent(final List<Shop> shops, final Player player, final Inventory inventory) {
026
027    this.player = player;
028    this.shops = shops;
029    this.inventory = inventory;
030  }
031}
